entries.2f24cb96eea8e4d0: This business sells paper and paper-processed products manufactured from raw materials such as wood. Its core products are high value-added specialty papers, with product categories including fancy paper, fine board, premium printing paper, basic paper and technical paper. The company and consolidated subsidiaries Tsujiwa Co., Ltd. and Heiwa Paper (Hong Kong) Co., Limited handle sales, and consolidated subsidiary Heiwa Kosan Co., Ltd. handles logistics, storage and paper processing for the group’s products. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥15,786 million.
entries.54fa7cafb2270880: It has its head office and Tokyo Head Office in Chuo-ku, Tokyo, and is a group consisting of three consolidated subsidiaries. As of March 31, 2026, it had 188 employees and is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Standard Market. Its business consists of two reportable segments: Japanese and Western Paper Wholesale and Real Estate Leasing.
entries.77b876588d63de22: A paper specialty trading company whose main products are high-value-added specialty papers, which also handles paper logistics and processing and real estate leasing.
entries.84b19814f48f1f64: The business buys, sells, leases, manages and brokers real estate. The company leases real estate to Heiwa Kousan Co., Ltd. and other customers, and also leases the Osaka office building, a rental condominium in Nagoya, and time-based parking lots. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥10 million.
